items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: if I saw Roy or Art Blakey or any of those guys in later life when I got to know them

ctx.x: Oh. Well an acquaintance named Art Bailey gave me that little inside scoop.
Well yeah, that’s cool. I bet I told Art that.

Yes, I think you did. Did you have — did your goals change as things went along? Because you went to the other end of the country to play with Gary Burton, or I’m not sure I’m correct about that but you relocated, is that correct?
